mapper.select: SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C WHERE C.PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND C.CTPT_MBR_SN = #{ctptMbrSn}
SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C WHERE C.PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND C.CTPT_MBR_SN = #{ctptMbrSn} FOR SHARE
mapper.sql: SELECT C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN , C.PST_SN , C.CTPT_MBR_SN , C.CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , C.REG_DT , C.MDFCN_DT , P.PST_TTL , P.MBR_SN AS OWNER_MBR_SN , O.MBR_NCNM AS OWNER_NCNM , O.ATCH_FILE_SN AS OWNER_ATCH_FILE_SN , A.MBR_NCNM AS APPLICANT_NCNM , A.ATCH_FILE_SN AS APPLICANT_ATCH_FILE_SN , R.PET_PRTC_RCRT_SN , R.RCRT_STTS_CD , T.PET_PRTC_MTCH_SN , T.MTCH_DLNG_STTS_CD FROM OTO_CHAT_ROOM C JOIN PST P ON P.PST_SN = C.PST_SN JOIN PET_PRTC_RCRT R ON R.PST_SN = C.PST_SN JOIN MBR O ON O.MBR_SN = P.MBR_SN JOIN MBR A ON A.MBR_SN = C.CTPT_MBR_SN LEFT JOIN PET_PRTC_MTCH T ON T.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN WHERE C.OTO_CHAT_ROOM_SN = #{otoChatRoomSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OTO_CHAT_ROOM ( PST_SN , CTPT_MBR_SN , CHAT_ROOM_STTS_CD , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{ctptMbrSn} , #{chatRoomSttsCd} , NOW() , NOW() )
